headword: {借|か}り{物|もの}{競走|きょうそう}

definitions.explanation: A sports-day race in which runners pick up a slip of paper naming an object or a kind of person, find and borrow it from the spectators, and run with it to the finish.

examples.japanese: {借|か}り{物|もの}{競走|きょうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I ran in the borrowing race.

examples.japanese: {借|か}り{物|もの}{競走|きょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「メガネ」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: In the borrowing race, I drew "glasses".

examples.japanese: {借|か}り{物|もの}{競走|きょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「{校長先生|こうちょうせんせい}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き→引く：01978_hiku⟧、⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: In the borrowing race I drew a slip that said "the principal", and ran to the finish pulling the principal by the hand.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A staple of the school ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧ (sports day) and of company and neighbourhood sports days. The fun lies in the slips: some name objects (a hat, a red towel), others people (someone wearing glasses, a teacher, "the person you like"), and the runner has to ask the crowd for help.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {借|か}り{物|もの}{競走|きょうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to take part in the borrowing race
- お{題|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw the slip with the task

WRITING:
The race is ⟦{競走|きょうそう}→競走：15644_kyousou⟧ (running race), not ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧ (competition).
